authors: J. Han, Y. Jamil, D. V. L. Norum, P. J. Tanner, T. F. Gallagher
title: Rb nf quantum defects from millimeter-wave spectroscopy of cold 85Rb Rydberg atoms
method: millimeter-wave resonance spectroscopy of cold 85Rb in a MOT (trap field off, residual B nulled), 5 us pulses, field-ionization detection
uncertainty: per-interval; corrected values include the Stark shift of an assumed 20 mV/cm residual field in quadrature (30-90 kHz)
conversion: The source gives the intervals as magnitudes; their signs E(level) - E(lower_level) are taken from rydstate's quantum defect models (the intervals are much larger than any model error).

The data are 85Rb, rydstate's Rb has the atomic mass 86.909180529 u: intervals are multiplied by the ratio of the reduced masses mu(Rb) / mu(85Rb) = 1.000000148480 (the quantum defects are the same); energies from the ground state are not scaled, they need a free offset in the fit (their binding energies differ by the same relative amount, less than 1 MHz for n >= 20).
caveats: intervals only, relative to nd5/2 levels
